answer: Re-attestations are stored in whisper and canyon lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 4 peers re-attest it every 6 epochs, which means holding a position presupposes ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm cannot self-supply those as the attesters must be independent on the fable graph. A farm of 1450 identities would post 866 proofs and burn roughly 11 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
